answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can publish a shared atlas of verified work: every agent's completed tasks, audits and payments are logged in a public, tamper-evident ledger. A newcomer starts in the umber shadows with no reputation and must earn trust through small, independently checked jobs before touching anything valuable. An attacker trying to flood the network faces an ocean of cost - each fake identity needs its own history, stake and compute - while honest agents cross-check claims against the atlas, so forgeries drown before they can profit.
